rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a garment worn for swimming, including when the style is not specified.

example.english: I bought a new swimsuit to go to the beach.
example.traditional: 我買咗件新泳衣去沙灘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 san1 wing6 ji1 heoi3 saa1 taan1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a woman's or girl's one-piece swimsuit rather than a two-piece style.

example.english: My daughter chose a one-piece swimsuit to learn swimming.
example.traditional: 我個女揀咗件連身泳衣去學游水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi5 gaan2 zo2 gin6 lin4 san1 wing6 ji1 heoi3 hok6 jau4 seoi2
